prompt:
Image 1 is a finished game sprite sheet of a leader whose drawing is right: keep exactly its camera (high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees), the direction every figure faces, every figure's pose, size and position in its cell, the 4 by 4 grid and the flat pure blue (#0000FF) background.
Image 2 is this leader's own approved painted portrait. Every figure of Image 1 must become the woman of the portrait, seen full length from above.

Repaint every figure of Image 1 as the woman of Image 2, the same in every cell. Keep each figure's pose, the position of its arms, legs and weapon, and its outline as close as the new kit allows. She has these marks, and each one must be clearly visible at full size: (1) the short conical leather cap stitched from four panels, ending in a small knot at the top; (2) her black hair in a thick knot at the nape held by a bone pin; (3) the cloak of sedge woven in a checker pattern of pale and dark reeds; (4) the clasp of braided eel-skin cord; (5) the plain straight sword with a simple cross guard. She carries no shield. Paint the marks in the portrait's hand: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, a muted earthy palette; nothing glows. Keep the daylight of Image 1 (a high sun from the upper left, a cool fill on the lower right); do not copy the portrait's candlelight, its dark background or its framing. She wears a reedman captain's kit instead of the iron cap and the padded jerkin of Image 1: her own leather cap as the portrait shows it, a cloak of plaited reeds over the shoulders and down the back as the portrait shows it, a dark brown leather jerkin under it, dark breeches and soft leather boots; she keeps the plain straight sword of Image 1 in the same hand.

Facing, again: every figure in every one of the cells faces the same way, toward us and to the lower left, including the figure that is hit and the falling one; the fleeing figures alone turn away.

Background: one flat pure blue (#0000FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor or shadow; no blue anywhere on the figures: no blue cloth, no blue light, no blue reflections. Never: text, labels, grid lines, borders, a floor, cast shadows, blood, extra people, cropped or overlapping figures.
